description: Executive summary — Condense a long report, memo or notes into an executive summary: bottom line up front, key findings, prioritized recommendations (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW with rationale), risks, decisions needed and key metrics, plus Markdown. Offline checks: every metric value verified against the source, numbers not in the source flagged, word target, compression and reading time. Optional: audience (default executives), maxWords (60-600, default 200). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Q3 revenue grew 14 percent to 3.2 million dollars, driven by the new enterprise tier, which added 41 customers. Churn fell from 6.1 percent to 4.5 percent after the onboarding redesign. Support tickets rose 22 percent and median response time slipped to 9 hours. Cash runway is 19 months. The team proposes hiring two support engineers and raising enterprise prices 8 percent in January.

name: ai_executive_summary
